C0310.title: Wan'an Public Security Cracks a DDoS Hacking Case
C0310.summary: In December 2022, Ji'an cyber police found during routine work that a local resident surnamed Song had launched DDoS attacks against a website, allegedly endangering network security. Cybersecurity police located Song through field checks and analysis, then summoned him to the public security organ. The investigation found that Song had obtained DDoS attack scripts while building websites for others and used a virtual machine to build an attack program that paralyzed the target website. He had also created an unauthorized channel for international internet access and was given administrative detention and a fine.
